summary.text: Laura Telerski is the Democratic candidate for New Hampshire State Senate District 13 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a state representative for Hillsborough 11 who took office in December 2022, is not running for re-election to that seat, and previously served as a Nashua selectwoman.

paragraphs.text: Telerski lives in Nashua, New Hampshire. She earned a B.A. in history from Georgetown University in 1993 and an M.A. in Middle Eastern studies from the University of Chicago in 1995.
She served as a Nashua selectwoman.
Telerski assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives on December 7, 2022, representing Hillsborough 11, and her term ends on December 2, 2026.
In 2023-2024 she served on the House Finance Committee and its Division III.
